name: lane-desktop
description: Lane 的 Electron 桌面壳

scripts.build:renderer: (cd ../web && bun run build) && rm -rf dist && cp -R ../web/dist dist
scripts.dev: bun run build && ((cd ../web && exec bun run dev) & VITE_PID=$!; trap 'kill $VITE_PID' EXIT; electron . --dev)
scripts.start: bun run build:renderer && bun run build && electron .
scripts.package: bun run build:renderer && bun run build && node scripts/bundle-runtime.mjs && ELECTRON_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron/ ELECTRON_BUILDER_BINARIES_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron-builder-binaries/ electron-builder
scripts.package:linux: bun run build:renderer && bun run build && node scripts/bundle-runtime.mjs && ELECTRON_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron/ ELECTRON_BUILDER_BINARIES_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron-builder-binaries/ electron-builder --linux AppImage --x64
scripts.package:win: bun run build:renderer && bun run build && node scripts/bundle-runtime.mjs && ELECTRON_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron/ ELECTRON_BUILDER_BINARIES_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron-builder-binaries/ electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.package:win:portable: bun run build:renderer && bun run build && node scripts/bundle-runtime.mjs && ELECTRON_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron/ ELECTRON_BUILDER_BINARIES_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron-builder-binaries/ electron-builder --win portable --x64
